matches.title: Parma vs Catania
matches.description: Watch Parma vs Catania highlights and goals from Coppa Italia on ReFooty: Football Highlights Hub. Match played on August 14, 2026. The Coppa Italia brought a fascinating clash between Parma and Catania on August 14, 2026, as both sides aimed to secure their place in the next round of the tournament. The atmosphere was charged with expectation for a match that promised tactical depth and individual brilliance. Lontani's First-Half Masterclass Parma took control of the proceedings early on, utilizing high pressure to disrupt Catania 's buildup play. After initial efforts from Adrián Bernabé and El Bilal Touré , the deadlock was finally broken in the 19th minute. Following a corner delivered by Emanuele Valeri , the ball fell to Simone Lontani , who fired a precise right-footed shot into the top right corner to give the hosts the lead. Catania attempted to respond immediately and nearly equalized in the 24th minute when Simone Leonardi tested the reflexes of Edoardo Corvi with a dangerous strike. However, it was Parma who struck again during a lethal counter-attack in the 35th minute. El Bilal Touré burst forward and provided a perfect cross for Simone Lontani , who made no mistake from close range to double his tally and the lead before the break. Management and Defensive Resilience Returning from the locker rooms, Catania introduced tactical changes with the arrivals of Alessandro Raimo and Michael Liguori to try and alter the course of the match. The Sicilian side came close to reducing the deficit through an Andrea Allegretto header, but Edoardo Corvi shone again with a steady save in the bottom corner. Catania goalkeeper Filippo Rinaldi also played a key role in preventing a heavier scoreline, stopping dangerous attempts from Enrico Delprato and Sascha Britschgi . In the final stages, the tempo slowed as both managers turned to their benches, including the introductions of Mandela Keita and Franco Carboni for Parma . Despite Catania 's late efforts, the home defense remained solid, securing a professional victory and progression to the next stage.
